name: FedRemoteSensing_Benchmark
description:
Dataset README
	


	
		
		1. General Information
	

Number of Labels: There are a total of 5 labels, namely: Agriculture, Bareland, Forest, Residential, and River.
Number of Clients: The dataset consists of 100 clients.
Data Volume per Client: Each client contains approximately 350 tif format images.

	
		
		2. Data Sources
	

All the images are collected from 6 different datasets, which are as follows:
Eurosat
UC Merced Land Use Dataset
AID
NWPU - RESISC45
WHU-RS19
NaSC-tg2
The data… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/billhdzhao/FedRemoteSensing_Benchmark.
reputation: A purpose-built federated remote sensing benchmark used by researchers exploring federated learning for land-use classification, but with limited broad adoption.
